build: Tasks, part 1: the page opens on today, with a week of days across the top and a calendar to go to any day; Nursery and Field as two lists with a photograph on every row; a tick records at once, and a late task is asked the day it was done in a popup calendar that says what each day would move; a task can be put off on purpose, skipped or given a note; late is judged against today, not against the week looked at.
